purpose: The agent uses staged LLM calls plus deterministic enrichment to turn PRD context into a device specification. It adds prices, dimensions, datasheet details, geometry primitives, wiring repairs, manufacturing data, and workspace section records before persisting the result.
summary: Generates and persists a structured hardware bill of materials, wiring graph, enclosure layout, and instructions.
